module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.Finsupp
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Basic
public import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.SMul

/-!
# The normed structure on the existing finite-support L1 metric

The finite-support carrier and Mathlib's existing L1 metric are retained.
Its norm is the distance from zero, hence the sum of the coordinate norms.
The inherited pointwise scalar operations make it a normed space without
passing to a completion or changing its topology.
-/

public section

noncomputable section

open scoped NNReal

universe u v w

namespace Finsupp

variable {ι : Type u} {E : Type v}

local instance : Fact ((1 : ℝ≥0) ≤ 1) := ⟨le_rfl⟩

private theorem l1DistOnSupport [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (a b : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) (s : Finset ι)
    (ha : a.ofLp.support ⊆ s) (hb : b.ofLp.support ⊆ s) :
    dist a b = ∑ i ∈ s, dist (a.ofLp i) (b.ofLp i) := by
  classical
  rw [Finsupp.dist_def]
  simp only [NNReal.coe_one, inv_one, Real.rpow_one]
  rw [Finsupp.sum_of_support_subset (s := s) _
    ((Finsupp.support_zipWith).trans (Finset.union_subset ha hb)) _ (by simp)]
  simp only [Finsupp.zipWith_apply]

/-- Translation preserves the existing finite-support L1 distance. -/
theorem l1_dist_add_left [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (a b c : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) :
    dist (c + a) (c + b) = dist a b := by
  classical
  let s := c.ofLp.support ∪ a.ofLp.support ∪ b.ofLp.support
  have hc : c.ofLp.support ⊆ s :=
    Finset.subset_union_left.trans Finset.subset_union_left
  have ha : a.ofLp.support ⊆ s :=
    Finset.subset_union_right.trans Finset.subset_union_left
  have hb : b.ofLp.support ⊆ s := Finset.subset_union_right
  have hca : (c + a).ofLp.support ⊆ s := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_add] using
      Finsupp.support_add.trans (Finset.union_subset hc ha)
  have hcb : (c + b).ofLp.support ⊆ s := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_add] using
      Finsupp.support_add.trans (Finset.union_subset hc hb)
  rw [l1DistOnSupport (c + a) (c + b) s hca hcb,
    l1DistOnSupport a b s ha hb]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_add, Finsupp.add_apply, dist_add_left]

/-- Mathlib's original finite-support L1 metric, captured before the normed extension. -/
abbrev l1Metric [NormedAddCommGroup E] :
    MetricSpace (WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) := inferInstance

/-- The L1 norm uses exactly the existing finite-support distance from zero. -/
instance instL1Norm [NormedAddCommGroup E] : Norm (WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) where
  norm x := dist 0 x

/-- The normed additive structure retains Mathlib's original L1 metric. -/
instance instL1NormedAddCommGroup [NormedAddCommGroup E] :
    NormedAddCommGroup (WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) :=
  NormedAddCommGroup.ofAddDist (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun x y z => le_of_eq (l1_dist_add_left x y z).symm)

private theorem l1NormedAddCommGroupMetricComputed [NormedAddCommGroup E] :
    (instL1NormedAddCommGroup (ι := ι) (E := E)).toMetricSpace =
      l1Metric (ι := ι) (E := E) := rfl

/-- The normed group has literally the original finite-support L1 metric. -/
theorem l1NormedAddCommGroup_metric_eq [NormedAddCommGroup E] :
    (instL1NormedAddCommGroup (ι := ι) (E := E)).toMetricSpace =
      l1Metric (ι := ι) (E := E) := l1NormedAddCommGroupMetricComputed

private theorem l1NormOnSupport [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (a : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) (s : Finset ι) (ha : a.ofLp.support ⊆ s) :
    ‖a‖ = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖a.ofLp i‖ := by
  change dist (0 : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) a = _
  rw [l1DistOnSupport 0 a s (by simp) ha]
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_zero, Finsupp.zero_apply, dist_zero_left]

/-- The norm is the finite sum of the original coordinate norms. -/
theorem l1_norm_eq_sum [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    (a : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) :
    ‖a‖ = a.ofLp.sum (fun _ x => ‖x‖) := by
  classical
  exact l1NormOnSupport a a.ofLp.support (by rfl)

variable {𝕜 : Type w} [NormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E]

/-- The existing finite-support L1 norm scales by the original scalar norm. -/
theorem l1_norm_smul (r : 𝕜) (a : WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) :
    ‖r • a‖ = ‖r‖ * ‖a‖ := by
  classical
  have hsupport : (r • a).ofLp.support ⊆ a.ofLp.support := by
    simpa only [WithLp.ofLp_smul] using (Finsupp.support_smul (b := r) (g := a.ofLp))
  rw [l1NormOnSupport (r • a) a.ofLp.support hsupport,
    l1NormOnSupport a a.ofLp.support (by rfl), Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [WithLp.ofLp_smul, Finsupp.smul_apply, norm_smul]

/-- The original pointwise scalar action is normed for the same L1 metric. -/
instance instL1NormedSpace : NormedSpace 𝕜 (WithLp (1 : ℝ≥0) (ι →₀ E)) where
  norm_smul_le r a := le_of_eq (l1_norm_smul r a)

end Finsupp

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpHolder

/-!
# Actual unit-coordinate equivalences of square-summable complex families

The actual coordinate map multiplies each coordinate by the given unit
scalar. Its reciprocal family is the inverse, and pointwise norm equality
proves the whole lp-two norm identity. Empty, finite and infinite indices
remain in the same type. No operator/unitary/spectrum output is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Lp
open scoped ENNReal
universe u

/-- Actual bounded unit-coordinate multiplication on the given lp-two family. -/
def unitCoordinateMap {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1) :
    lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2 →L[ℂ] lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2 :=
  lp.mapCLM 2 (fun i => beta i • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ ℂ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)
    (fun i => by simpa only [norm_smul, ContinuousLinearMap.norm_id, mul_one] using (hunit i).le)

/-- Literal coordinate value of the actual unit map. -/
theorem unitCoordinateMap_apply {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) (i : I) : unitCoordinateMap beta hunit x i = beta i * x i := rfl

/-- Given unit scalars are genuinely nonzero. -/
theorem unitCoordinate_ne_zero {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1) (i : I) :
    beta i ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have h := hunit i
  rw [hz, norm_zero] at h
  exact zero_ne_one h

/-- The actual reciprocal scalar family is unit valued. -/
theorem inverseUnitCoordinates {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1) :
    ∀ i, ‖(beta i)⁻¹‖ = 1 := fun i => by rw [norm_inv, hunit i, inv_one]

/-- The actual reciprocal diagonal is a left inverse. -/
theorem unitCoordinateMap_left_inv {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) :
    unitCoordinateMap (fun i => (beta i)⁻¹) (inverseUnitCoordinates beta hunit)
      (unitCoordinateMap beta hunit x) = x := by
  apply lp.ext
  apply funext
  intro i
  rw [unitCoordinateMap_apply, unitCoordinateMap_apply, ← mul_assoc,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (unitCoordinate_ne_zero beta hunit i), one_mul]

/-- The actual reciprocal diagonal is a right inverse. -/
theorem unitCoordinateMap_right_inv {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) :
    unitCoordinateMap beta hunit
      (unitCoordinateMap (fun i => (beta i)⁻¹) (inverseUnitCoordinates beta hunit) x) = x := by
  apply lp.ext
  apply funext
  intro i
  rw [unitCoordinateMap_apply, unitCoordinateMap_apply, ← mul_assoc,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ (unitCoordinate_ne_zero beta hunit i), one_mul]

/-- Actual unit-coordinate map preserves the whole square-summable norm. -/
theorem unitCoordinateMap_norm {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) : ‖unitCoordinateMap beta hunit x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  have he : ∀ i, ‖unitCoordinateMap beta hunit x i‖ = ‖x i‖ := by
    intro i
    rw [unitCoordinateMap_apply, norm_mul, hunit i, one_mul]
  exact le_antisymm
    (lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) (fun i => (he i).le))
    (lp.norm_mono (by norm_num : (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0) (fun i => (he i).ge))

/-- Actual unit-coordinate isometric equivalence with its literal reciprocal inverse. -/
def unitCoordinateEquiv {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1) :
    lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2 ≃ₗᵢ[ℂ] lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2 where
  toFun := unitCoordinateMap beta hunit
  invFun := unitCoordinateMap (fun i => (beta i)⁻¹) (inverseUnitCoordinates beta hunit)
  left_inv := unitCoordinateMap_left_inv beta hunit
  right_inv := unitCoordinateMap_right_inv beta hunit
  map_add' := (unitCoordinateMap beta hunit).map_add
  map_smul' := (unitCoordinateMap beta hunit).map_smul
  norm_map' := unitCoordinateMap_norm beta hunit

/-- Literal actual forward coordinate of the canonical equivalence. -/
theorem unitCoordinateEquiv_apply {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) (i : I) : unitCoordinateEquiv beta hunit x i = beta i * x i := rfl

/-- Literal actual reciprocal coordinate of the canonical inverse. -/
theorem unitCoordinateEquiv_symm_apply {I : Type u} (beta : I → ℂ) (hunit : ∀ i, ‖beta i‖ = 1)
    (x : lp (fun _ : I => ℂ) 2) (i : I) : (unitCoordinateEquiv beta hunit).symm x i = (beta i)⁻¹ * x i := rfl

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Lp

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.PiTensorProduct.ProjectiveSeminorm
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorPower.Basic
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Multilinear.Curry

/-!
# Projective seminorm bound for actual tensor-power concatenation

The actual graded product is bounded by the product of the projective
seminorms. The seminormed version is required by the source smooth tensor
seminorm, whose original p need not separate vectors. The two projective
lifts construct the bounded bilinear map from the actual pure-tensor map;
no multiplication bound or norm model is an input.
-/

@[expose] public section
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option relaxedAutoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped TensorProduct BigOperators
namespace TensorPower
universe uK uV
variable {𝕜 : Type uK} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]
variable {V : Type uV} [SeminormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace 𝕜 V]

/-- Actual concatenation of two tensor powers has the projective product bound,
including degenerate seminorms and zero tensor powers. -/
theorem norm_gMul_le {m n : ℕ} (x : TensorPower 𝕜 m V) (y : TensorPower 𝕜 n V) :
    ‖@GradedMonoid.GMul.mul ℕ (fun k => TensorPower 𝕜 k V) _ _ m n x y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖ := by
  let f : MultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin m => V)
      (MultilinearMap 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n => V) (TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V)) :=
    MultilinearMap.currySum
      ((PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 (s := fun _ : Fin (m + n) => V)).domDomCongr finSumFinEquiv.symm)
  let GM : TensorPower 𝕜 m V →ₗ[𝕜] TensorPower 𝕜 n V →ₗ[𝕜] TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V :=
    (TensorProduct.mk 𝕜 _ _).compr₂
      (TensorPower.mulEquiv (R := 𝕜) (M := V) (n := m) (m := n)).toLinearMap
  have hf (a : Fin m → V) (b : Fin n → V) :
      f a b = GM (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 a) (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 b) := by
    change f a b = @GradedMonoid.GMul.mul ℕ (fun k => TensorPower 𝕜 k V) _ _ m n
      (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 a) (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 b)
    rw [TensorPower.tprod_mul_tprod]
    change PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 (fun i => Sum.elim a b (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)) =
      PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 (Fin.append a b)
    congr 1
    dsimp only [Fin.append, finSumFinEquiv, Equiv.coe_fn_symm_mk]
    apply funext
    apply Fin.addCases <;> simp
  have hfBound (a : Fin m → V) (b : Fin n → V) :
      ‖f a b‖ ≤ (1 * ∏ i, ‖a i‖) * ∏ j, ‖b j‖ := by
    change ‖PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 (fun i => Sum.elim a b (finSumFinEquiv.symm i))‖ ≤ _
    have hprod :
        (∏ i : Fin (m + n), ‖Sum.elim a b (finSumFinEquiv.symm i)‖) =
          (∏ i : Fin m, ‖a i‖) * ∏ j : Fin n, ‖b j‖ := by
      exact ((finSumFinEquiv.symm).prod_comp
        (fun i : Fin m ⊕ Fin n => ‖Sum.elim a b i‖)).trans (by
          simp only [Fintype.prod_sum_type, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr])
    simpa only [_root_.one_mul, hprod] using
      PiTensorProduct.projectiveSeminorm_tprod_le (𝕜 := 𝕜)
        (fun i : Fin (m + n) => Sum.elim a b (finSumFinEquiv.symm i))
  let fc := MultilinearMap.mkContinuousMultilinear f 1 hfBound
  let L := (PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n => V)
    (TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V)).toLinearIsometry
  let outer := L.toContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap fc
  let B := PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin m => V)
    (TensorPower 𝕜 n V →L[𝕜] TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V) outer
  have hnorm : ‖B‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hfc : ‖fc‖ ≤ 1 :=
      MultilinearMap.mkContinuousMultilinear_norm_le f zero_le_one hfBound
    have ho : ‖outer‖ = ‖fc‖ := L.norm_compContinuousMultilinearMap fc
    have hb : ‖B‖ = ‖outer‖ :=
      (PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin m => V)
        (TensorPower 𝕜 n V →L[𝕜] TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V)).norm_map outer
    exact hb.trans_le (ho.trans_le hfc)
  have hpure (a : Fin m → V) (b : Fin n → V) :
      B (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 a) (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 b) = f a b := by
    dsimp only [B]
    rw [PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry_apply_apply, PiTensorProduct.lift.tprod]
    change outer a (PiTensorProduct.tprod 𝕜 b) = f a b
    have houter : outer a = PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry 𝕜 (fun _ : Fin n => V)
        (TensorPower 𝕜 (m + n) V) (fc a) := by
      simp only [outer, L, ContinuousLinearMap.compContinuousMultilinearMap_coe, Function.comp_apply,
        LinearIsometry.coe_toContinuousLinearMap, LinearIsometryEquiv.coe_toLinearIsometry]
    rw [houter]
    rw [PiTensorProduct.liftIsometry_apply_apply, PiTensorProduct.lift.tprod]
    rfl
  have hvalue : B x y = GM x y := by
    induction x using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
    | smul_tprod c a =>
      induction y using PiTensorProduct.induction_on with
      | smul_tprod d b =>
        simp only [map_smul, _root_.smul_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply]
        rw [hpure]
        simpa only [_root_.smul_smul, _root_.mul_comm] using
          congrArg (fun z => c • (d • z)) (hf a b)
      | add y₁ y₂ h₁ h₂ =>
        simpa only [map_add] using congrArg₂ (fun a b => a + b) h₁ h₂
    | add x₁ x₂ h₁ h₂ =>
      simpa only [map_add, _root_.add_apply, LinearMap.add_apply] using
        congrArg₂ (fun a b => a + b) h₁ h₂
  change ‖GM x y‖ ≤ ‖x‖ * ‖y‖
  rw [← hvalue]
  calc
    ‖B x y‖ ≤ ‖B x‖ * ‖y‖ := (B x).le_opNorm y
    _ ≤ (‖B‖ * ‖x‖) * ‖y‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (B.le_opNorm x) (norm_nonneg y)
    _ ≤ (1 * ‖x‖) * ‖y‖ := by gcongr
    _ = _ := by rw [_root_.one_mul]

end TensorPower

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.LocallyConvex.WithSeminorms
public import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Group.Quotient

/-!
# Quotient seminorms

This file defines the seminorm induced on a module quotient by a seminorm on
the original module. It proves the infimum formula, identifies quotient balls
with images of balls, and transports a seminorm-generated topology to the
quotient using finite suprema of the original family.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Filter Set Topology
open scoped NNReal Topology

noncomputable section

universe u v

namespace Seminorm

/-- The quotient seminorm induced by `p` on `X ⧸ Y`. -/
noncomputable def quotient
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜]
    {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module 𝕜 X]
    (p : Seminorm 𝕜 X) (Y : Submodule 𝕜 X) :
    Seminorm 𝕜 (X ⧸ Y) := by
  let _ : SeminormedAddCommGroup X := p.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
  let _ : NormedSpace 𝕜 X :=
    { norm_smul_le := fun a x ↦ le_of_eq (map_smul_eq_mul p a x) }
  exact normSeminorm 𝕜 (X ⧸ Y)

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The quotient seminorm is the infimum over representatives of the coset. -/
@[simp]
theorem quotient_mkQ
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜]
    {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module 𝕜 X]
    (p : Seminorm 𝕜 X) (Y : Submodule 𝕜 X) (x : X) :
    p.quotient Y (Y.mkQ x) =
      sInf (Set.range fun y : Y ↦ p (x + (y : X))) := by
  let _ : SeminormedAddCommGroup X := p.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
  let _ : NormedSpace 𝕜 X :=
    { norm_smul_le := fun a z ↦ le_of_eq (map_smul_eq_mul p a z) }
  change ‖(Y.mkQ x : X ⧸ Y)‖ =
    sInf (Set.range fun y : Y ↦ p (x + (y : X)))
  rw [show Y.mkQ x = QuotientAddGroup.mk' Y.toAddSubgroup x from rfl,
    quotient_norm_mk_eq]
  congr 1
  ext r
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, hzr⟩
    refine ⟨⟨z, hz⟩, ?_⟩
    change p (x + z) = r at hzr
    exact hzr
  · rintro ⟨z, hzr⟩
    refine ⟨(z : X), z.property, ?_⟩
    change p (x + (z : X)) = r
    exact hzr

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The quotient image of a seminorm ball is the corresponding quotient
seminorm ball. -/
theorem image_ball_quotient
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜]
    {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module 𝕜 X]
    (p : Seminorm 𝕜 X) (Y : Submodule 𝕜 X) (ε : ℝ) :
    Y.mkQ '' p.ball 0 ε = (p.quotient Y).ball 0 ε := by
  let _ : SeminormedAddCommGroup X := p.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
  let _ : NormedSpace 𝕜 X :=
    { norm_smul_le := fun a z ↦ le_of_eq (map_smul_eq_mul p a z) }
  ext z
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [Seminorm.mem_ball, sub_zero]
    change ‖(Y.mkQ x : X ⧸ Y)‖ < ε
    have hx' : ‖x‖ < ε := by
      change p x < ε
      simpa using hx
    exact (Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_le Y x).trans_lt hx'
  · intro hz
    rw [Seminorm.mem_ball, sub_zero] at hz
    change ‖z‖ < ε at hz
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxlt⟩ :=
      Submodule.Quotient.norm_mk_lt z (sub_pos.mpr hz)
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hx⟩
    rw [Seminorm.mem_ball, sub_zero]
    change ‖x‖ < ε
    linarith

end Seminorm

namespace WithSeminorms

/-- Finite suprema of a generating seminorm family induce the quotient
topology after passing to their quotient seminorms. -/
theorem quotient
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NormedField 𝕜]
    {X : Type u} [AddCommGroup X] [Module 𝕜 X]
    [TopologicalSpace X]
    {ι : Type v} [Nonempty ι] {p : ι → Seminorm 𝕜 X}
    (hp : WithSeminorms p) (Y : Submodule 𝕜 X) :
    WithSeminorms (fun s : Finset ι ↦ (s.sup p).quotient Y) := by
  let _ : IsTopologicalAddGroup X := hp.isTopologicalAddGroup
  let q : Finset ι → Seminorm 𝕜 (X ⧸ Y) := fun s ↦
    (s.sup p).quotient Y
  have hmap : Filter.map Y.mkQ (𝓝 (0 : X)) = 𝓝 (0 : X ⧸ Y) := by
    rw [← Y.mkQ.map_zero]
    exact Y.isOpenMap_mkQ.map_nhds_eq Y.continuous_mkQ.continuousAt
  have hsource := hp.hasBasis_zero_ball.map Y.mkQ
  rw [hmap] at hsource
  have hsingle : (𝓝 (0 : X ⧸ Y)).HasBasis
      (fun z : Finset ι × ℝ ↦ 0 < z.2)
      (fun z ↦ (q z.1).ball 0 z.2) := by
    refine hsource.congr (fun _ ↦ Iff.rfl) ?_
    intro z _hz
    simpa [q] using (z.1.sup p).image_ball_quotient Y z.2
  apply SeminormFamily.withSeminorms_of_hasBasis q
  refine hsingle.to_hasBasis ?_ ?_
  · rintro ⟨s, ε⟩ hε
    refine ⟨(q s).ball 0 ε, ?_, Subset.rfl⟩
    rw [SeminormFamily.basisSets_iff]
    exact ⟨{s}, ε, hε, by simp⟩
  · intro U hU
    rw [SeminormFamily.basisSets_iff] at hU
    rcases hU with ⟨t, ε, hε, rfl⟩
    apply hsingle.mem_iff.mp
    rw [Seminorm.ball_finset_sup_eq_iInter q t 0 hε]
    change (⋂ i ∈ t, (q i).ball 0 ε) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : X ⧸ Y)
    rw [Filter.biInter_finset_mem]
    intro s _hs
    exact hsingle.mem_iff.mpr ⟨(s, ε), hε, Subset.rfl⟩

end WithSeminorms

/-!
# Continuous radial clipping into the closed unit ball

The radial clipping map rescales a vector only when its norm exceeds one.  It
is continuous, fixes the closed unit ball, and changes approximation to a
unit-ball target by at most a factor of two.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Module

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

/-- Radial clipping into the closed unit ball. -/
noncomputable def radialClip (x : E) : E :=
  (max 1 ‖x‖)⁻¹ • x

/-- Radial clipping is continuous. -/
theorem continuous_radialClip : Continuous (radialClip : E → E) := by
  have hden : Continuous fun x : E ↦ max 1 ‖x‖ :=
    continuous_const.max continuous_norm
  have hne : ∀ x : E, max 1 ‖x‖ ≠ 0 := fun x ↦
    ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans_le (le_max_left 1 ‖x‖))
  exact (hden.inv₀ hne).smul continuous_id

/-- Radial clipping takes values in the closed unit ball. -/
theorem norm_radialClip_le_one (x : E) : ‖radialClip x‖ ≤ 1 := by
  by_cases hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1
  · simpa [radialClip, max_eq_left hx] using hx
  · have hx' : 1 < ‖x‖ := lt_of_not_ge hx
    have hpos : 0 < ‖x‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (zero_lt_one.trans hx')
    rw [radialClip, max_eq_right hx'.le, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos hpos, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (zero_lt_one.trans hx'))]

/-- Radial clipping is the identity on the closed unit ball. -/
theorem radialClip_eq_self {x : E} (hx : ‖x‖ ≤ 1) : radialClip x = x := by
  simp [radialClip, max_eq_left hx]

/-- Clipping an approximant increases its distance to a unit-ball target by at
most a factor of two. -/
theorem norm_sub_radialClip_le_two_mul (w z : E) (hw : ‖w‖ ≤ 1) :
    ‖w - radialClip z‖ ≤ 2 * ‖w - z‖ := by
  by_cases hz : ‖z‖ ≤ 1
  · rw [radialClip_eq_self hz]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (w - z)]
  · have hz' : 1 < ‖z‖ := lt_of_not_ge hz
    have hznorm : 0 < ‖z‖ := zero_lt_one.trans hz'
    have hinvle : ‖z‖⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hznorm).2 hz'.le
    have hclip : ‖z - radialClip z‖ = ‖z‖ - 1 := by
      calc
        ‖z - radialClip z‖ = ‖(1 - ‖z‖⁻¹) • z‖ := by
          congr 1
          rw [radialClip, max_eq_right hz'.le]
          symm
          rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
        _ = |1 - ‖z‖⁻¹| * ‖z‖ := norm_smul _ _
        _ = (1 - ‖z‖⁻¹) * ‖z‖ := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hinvle)]
        _ = ‖z‖ - 1 := by
          field_simp
    have hzw : ‖z‖ - 1 ≤ ‖z - w‖ := by
      calc
        ‖z‖ - 1 ≤ ‖z‖ - ‖w‖ := sub_le_sub_left hw ‖z‖
        _ ≤ |‖z‖ - ‖w‖| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ‖z - w‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le z w
    calc
      ‖w - radialClip z‖ = ‖(w - z) + (z - radialClip z)‖ := by
        congr 1
        abel
      _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z - radialClip z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖w - z‖ + ‖z - w‖ := add_le_add_right (hclip.trans_le hzw) _
      _ = 2 * ‖w - z‖ := by rw [norm_sub_rev]; ring

end MathlibExt.Analysis.Normed.Module

module

public import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.RegularizedHypergeometric

/-!
# The parabolic-cylinder function U

The function `Complex.parabolicCylinderU a z` has the standard normalization
`U(a,z) = D_{-a-1/2}(z)`. Its two defining confluent hypergeometric series are
entire in `z`. The Gamma factors converting the native regularized series to
ordinary confluent hypergeometric functions are retained explicitly.

The differential equation and initial values identify the classical solution.
This is the cylinder normalization used in Helfgott, *Major arcs for Goldbach's
problem*, arXiv:1305.2897v4, §3.2, equation (3.8), and DLMF §12.2.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Complex

private def cf (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  regularizedHGFunCoeff ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) n

private lemma cf_eq (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    cf a b n = (ascPochhammer ℂ n).eval a / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (b + n)) := by
  simp [cf, regularizedHGFunCoeff]

private lemma cf_succ (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1 : ℂ) * cf a b (n + 1) = a * cf (a + 1) (b + 1) n := by
  rw [cf_eq, cf_eq, ascPochhammer_succ_left, Nat.factorial_succ]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_comp,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_one, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  rw [show b + 1 + (n : ℂ) = b + ((n : ℂ) + 1) by ring]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
  have hn : (n + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
  calc
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℂ) * (n + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹) *
        (a * (ascPochhammer ℂ n).eval (a + 1) *
          (n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Gamma (b + (n + 1)))⁻¹) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hn]; ring

private lemma cf_hasSum (a b z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => cf a b n * z ^ n)
      (regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) z) := by
  have hr : (regularizedHGFunSeries ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ)).radius = ⊤ :=
    radius_regularizedHGFunSeries_eq_top (by simp)
  have h := (regularizedHGFunSeries ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ)).hasSum
    (x := z) (by simp [hr])
  simpa only [FormalMultilinearSeries.apply_eq_pow_smul_coeff, regularizedHGFunSeries_coeff,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, cf, regularizedHGFun] using h

private lemma hasDerivAt_regularizedConfluent (a b z : ℂ) :
    HasDerivAt (regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ))
      (a * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) z) z := by
  let p := regularizedHGFunSeries ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ)
  have hr : p.radius = ⊤ := radius_regularizedHGFunSeries_eq_top (by simp)
  have hdr : p.derivSeries.radius = ⊤ := by
    apply top_le_iff.mp
    simpa only [hr] using p.radius_le_radius_derivSeries
  have hd := (p.hasFDerivAt_sum (x := z) (by simp [hr])).hasDerivAt
  have hs := (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ (1 : ℂ)).hasSum
    (p.derivSeries.hasSum (x := z) (by simp [hdr]))
  have hcf : ∀ n : ℕ, (p.derivSeries n (fun _ => z)) 1 =
      a * (cf (a + 1) (b + 1) n * z ^ n) := by
    intro n
    rw [FormalMultilinearSeries.apply_eq_pow_smul_coeff]
    simp only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, p.derivSeries_coeff_one,
      nsmul_eq_mul, p, regularizedHGFunSeries_coeff, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    change z ^ n * ((n + 1 : ℂ) * cf a b (n + 1)) = _
    rw [cf_succ]
    ring
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ => (ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℂ ℂ (1 : ℂ))
      (p.derivSeries n (fun _ => z))) = fun n : ℕ => a * (cf (a + 1) (b + 1) n * z ^ n) := by
    funext n
    exact hcf n
  rw [heq] at hs
  have he := hs.unique ((cf_hasSum (a + 1) (b + 1) z).mul_left a)
  change (p.derivSeries.sum z) 1 = _ at he
  rw [he] at hd
  exact hd

private lemma cf_kummer (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 1 : ℂ) * (n + b) * cf a b (n + 1) = (n + a) * cf a b n := by
  rw [cf_eq, cf_eq, ascPochhammer_succ_eval, Nat.factorial_succ]
  simp only [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]
  rw [show b + ((n : ℂ) + 1) = b + (n : ℂ) + 1 by ring]
  rw [one_div_Gamma_eq_self_mul_one_div_Gamma_add_one (b + n)]
  have hn : (n + 1 : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.succ_ne_zero n
  calc
    _ = ((n + 1 : ℂ) * (n + 1 : ℂ)⁻¹) *
      ((n + b) * (n + a) * (ascPochhammer ℂ n).eval a *
        (n.factorial : ℂ)⁻¹ * (Gamma (b + n + 1))⁻¹) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hn]; ring

private lemma cf_succ_succ (a b : ℂ) (n : ℕ) :
    (n + 2 : ℂ) * (n + 1) * cf a b (n + 2) =
      a * (a + 1) * cf (a + 2) (b + 2) n := by
  calc
    _ = (n + 1 : ℂ) * ((n + 2) * cf a b (n + 2)) := by ring
    _ = (n + 1 : ℂ) * (a * cf (a + 1) (b + 1) (n + 1)) := by
      rw [show n + 2 = (n + 1) + 1 by omega]
      have h := congrArg (fun x : ℂ => (n + 1) * x) (cf_succ a b (n + 1))
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, add_assoc, one_add_one_eq_two] using h
    _ = a * ((n + 1 : ℂ) * cf (a + 1) (b + 1) (n + 1)) := by ring
    _ = a * ((a + 1) * cf ((a + 1) + 1) ((b + 1) + 1) n) := by rw [cf_succ]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [show (a + 1) + 1 = a + 2 by ring, show (b + 1) + 1 = b + 2 by ring]
      ring

private lemma cf_deriv_hasSum (a b z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n + 1 : ℂ) * cf a b (n + 1) * z ^ n)
      (a * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) z) := by
  have h := (cf_hasSum (a + 1) (b + 1) z).mul_left a
  convert h using 1
  funext n
  rw [cf_succ]
  ring

private lemma cf_deriv_deriv_hasSum (a b z : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n + 2 : ℂ) * (n + 1) * cf a b (n + 2) * z ^ n)
      (a * (a + 1) * regularizedHGFun ({a + 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 2} : Multiset ℂ) z) := by
  have h := (cf_hasSum (a + 2) (b + 2) z).mul_left (a * (a + 1))
  convert h using 1
  funext n
  rw [cf_succ_succ]
  ring

private lemma regularizedConfluent_ode (a b z : ℂ) :
    z * (a * (a + 1) * regularizedHGFun ({a + 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 2} : Multiset ℂ) z) +
      (b - z) * (a * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) z) -
      a * regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) z = 0 := by
  let vA := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * (n + 1) * cf a b (n + 1) * z ^ n
  let vC := fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * cf a b n * z ^ n
  have hAtail : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => vA (n + 1))
      (z * (a * (a + 1) * regularizedHGFun ({a + 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 2} : Multiset ℂ) z)) := by
    convert (cf_deriv_deriv_hasSum a b z).mul_left z using 1
    funext n
    dsimp only [vA]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, Nat.add_assoc, pow_succ]
    ring
  have hA := hAtail.zero_add
  have hvA : vA 0 = 0 := by simp [vA]
  rw [hvA, zero_add] at hA
  have hCtail : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => vC (n + 1))
      (z * (a * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) z)) := by
    convert (cf_deriv_hasSum a b z).mul_left z using 1
    funext n
    dsimp only [vC]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, pow_succ]
    ring
  have hC := hCtail.zero_add
  have hvC : vC 0 = 0 := by simp [vC]
  rw [hvC, zero_add] at hC
  have hB := (cf_deriv_hasSum a b z).mul_left b
  have hD := (cf_hasSum a b z).mul_left a
  have h := ((hA.add hB).sub hC).sub hD
  have heq : (fun n : ℕ =>
      (vA n + b * ((n + 1 : ℂ) * cf a b (n + 1) * z ^ n) - vC n) -
        a * (cf a b n * z ^ n)) = fun _ : ℕ => (0 : ℂ) := by
    funext n
    dsimp only [vA, vC]
    calc
      _ = ((n + 1 : ℂ) * (n + b) * cf a b (n + 1) - (n + a) * cf a b n) * z ^ n := by
        ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [cf_kummer]; ring
  rw [heq] at h
  have hzero := h.unique hasSum_zero
  convert hzero using 1; ring



/-- Ordinary confluent series, used here only at the positive denominator
parameters `1/2` and `3/2`. -/
private abbrev m (a b z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Gamma b * regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) z

private abbrev m1 (a b z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Gamma b * a * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) z

private abbrev m2 (a b z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Gamma b * a * (a + 1) * regularizedHGFun ({a + 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 2} : Multiset ℂ) z

private lemma deriv_m (a b z : ℂ) : deriv (m a b) z = m1 a b z := by
  rw [show m a b = fun w : ℂ => Gamma b * regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) w
    by rfl]
  have h := (hasDerivAt_regularizedConfluent a b z).const_mul (Gamma b)
  simpa only [m1, mul_assoc] using h.deriv

private lemma deriv_m1 (a b z : ℂ) : deriv (m1 a b) z = m2 a b z := by
  rw [show m1 a b = fun w : ℂ =>
    (Gamma b * a) * regularizedHGFun ({a + 1} : Multiset ℂ) ({b + 1} : Multiset ℂ) w by rfl]
  have h := (hasDerivAt_regularizedConfluent (a + 1) (b + 1) z).const_mul (Gamma b * a)
  rw [show (a + 1) + 1 = a + 2 by ring, show (b + 1) + 1 = b + 2 by ring] at h
  simpa only [m2, mul_assoc] using h.deriv

private lemma m_ode (a b z : ℂ) : z * m2 a b z + (b - z) * m1 a b z - a * m a b z = 0 := by
  have h := congrArg (fun w : ℂ => Gamma b * w) (regularizedConfluent_ode a b z)
  dsimp only [m, m1, m2]
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

private lemma analyticAt_m (a b z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (m a b) z := by
  exact analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_regularizedHGFun_of_card_le (by simp) z)

private lemma analyticAt_m1 (a b z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (m1 a b) z := by
  exact analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_regularizedHGFun_of_card_le (by simp) z)

private abbrev gaussianFactor (z : ℂ) : ℂ := exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4)

private lemma analyticAt_gaussianFactor (z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ gaussianFactor z := by
  unfold gaussianFactor
  fun_prop

private lemma deriv_gaussianFactor (z : ℂ) : deriv gaussianFactor z = -(z / 2) * gaussianFactor z := by
  have h := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4)).comp z
    (((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).neg.div_const 4)
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.neg_apply, id_eq,
    Nat.reduceSub, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, mul_one] at hd
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => exp (-(w ^ 2) / 4)) z = _
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by unfold gaussianFactor; ring

private def evenWeber (a z : ℂ) : ℂ := gaussianFactor z * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)

private def oddWeber (a z : ℂ) : ℂ := gaussianFactor z * z * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)

private abbrev evenFirst (a z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  gaussianFactor z * (z * m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) - z / 2 * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))

private abbrev evenSecond (a z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  gaussianFactor z * ((z ^ 2 / 4 - 1 / 2) * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
    (1 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) + z ^ 2 * m2 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))

private abbrev oddFirst (a z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  gaussianFactor z * ((1 - z ^ 2 / 2) * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
    z ^ 2 * m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))

private abbrev oddSecond (a z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  gaussianFactor z * z * ((z ^ 2 / 4 - 3 / 2) * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
    (3 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) + z ^ 2 * m2 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))

private lemma analyticAt_evenWeber (a z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (evenWeber a) z := by
  have hg : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 / 2) z := by fun_prop
  exact (analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).mul
    ((analyticAt_m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).comp (f := fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 / 2) (x := z) hg)

private lemma analyticAt_oddWeber (a z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (oddWeber a) z := by
  have hg : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 / 2) z := by fun_prop
  exact ((analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).mul analyticAt_id).mul
    ((analyticAt_m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).comp (f := fun w : ℂ => w ^ 2 / 2) (x := z) hg)

private lemma deriv_evenWeber (a z : ℂ) : deriv (evenWeber a) z = evenFirst a z := by
  have hp := (analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_gaussianFactor] at hp
  have hm := (analyticAt_m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m] at hm
  have hc := hm.comp z (((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2)
  have h := hp.mul hc
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq,
    Nat.reduceSub, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, mul_one] at hd
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => gaussianFactor w * m a (1 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2)) z = _
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by unfold evenFirst; ring

private lemma deriv_evenFirst (a z : ℂ) : deriv (evenFirst a) z = evenSecond a z := by
  have hp := (analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_gaussianFactor] at hp
  have hm := (analyticAt_m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m] at hm
  have hm1 := (analyticAt_m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m1] at hm1
  have hw := ((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2
  have hc := hm.comp z hw
  have hc1 := hm1.comp z hw
  have h := hp.mul (((hasDerivAt_id z).mul hc1).sub (((hasDerivAt_id z).div_const 2).mul hc))
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.sub_apply, id_eq,
    Nat.reduceSub, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, mul_one] at hd
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => gaussianFactor w *
    (w * m1 a (1 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2) - w / 2 * m a (1 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2))) z = _
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by unfold evenSecond; ring

private lemma deriv_oddWeber (a z : ℂ) : deriv (oddWeber a) z = oddFirst a z := by
  have hp := (analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_gaussianFactor] at hp
  have hm := (analyticAt_m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m] at hm
  have hc := hm.comp z (((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2)
  have h := (hp.mul (hasDerivAt_id z)).mul hc
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, id_eq,
    Nat.reduceSub, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, mul_one] at hd
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => gaussianFactor w * w * m a (3 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2)) z = _
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by unfold oddFirst; ring

private lemma deriv_oddFirst (a z : ℂ) : deriv (oddFirst a) z = oddSecond a z := by
  have hp := (analyticAt_gaussianFactor z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_gaussianFactor] at hp
  have hm := (analyticAt_m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m] at hm
  have hm1 := (analyticAt_m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_m1] at hm1
  have hw := ((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).div_const 2
  have hc := hm.comp z hw
  have hc1 := hm1.comp z hw
  have h := hp.mul ((((hasDerivAt_const z (1 : ℂ)).sub hw).mul hc).add
    (((hasDerivAt_id z).pow 2).mul hc1))
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.mul_apply, Pi.pow_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, id_eq,
    Nat.reduceSub, Nat.cast_ofNat, pow_one, mul_one] at hd
  change deriv (fun w : ℂ => gaussianFactor w *
    ((1 - w ^ 2 / 2) * m a (3 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2) + w ^ 2 * m1 a (3 / 2) (w ^ 2 / 2))) z = _
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by unfold oddSecond; ring

private lemma evenSecond_eq (a z : ℂ) :
    evenSecond a z = (z ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * a - 1 / 2) * evenWeber a z := by
  have hc : z ^ 2 * m2 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
      (1 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) = 2 * a * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
    calc
      _ = 2 * (z ^ 2 / 2 * m2 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
          (1 / 2 - z ^ 2 / 2) * m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) - a * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)) +
          2 * a * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [m_ode]; ring
  change gaussianFactor z * _ = _ * (gaussianFactor z * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))
  calc
    _ = gaussianFactor z * ((z ^ 2 / 4 - 1 / 2) * m a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
        (z ^ 2 * m2 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) + (1 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hc]; ring

private lemma oddSecond_eq (a z : ℂ) :
    oddSecond a z = (z ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * a - 3 / 2) * oddWeber a z := by
  have hc : z ^ 2 * m2 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
      (3 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) = 2 * a * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
    calc
      _ = 2 * (z ^ 2 / 2 * m2 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
          (3 / 2 - z ^ 2 / 2) * m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) - a * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)) +
          2 * a * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [m_ode]; ring
  change gaussianFactor z * z * _ = _ * (gaussianFactor z * z * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))
  calc
    _ = gaussianFactor z * z * ((z ^ 2 / 4 - 3 / 2) * m a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
        (z ^ 2 * m2 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2) + (3 - z ^ 2) * m1 a (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2))) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hc]; ring

private lemma deriv_deriv_evenWeber (a z : ℂ) :
    deriv (deriv (evenWeber a)) z = (z ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * a - 1 / 2) * evenWeber a z := by
  have h : deriv (evenWeber a) = evenFirst a := funext (deriv_evenWeber a)
  rw [h, deriv_evenFirst, evenSecond_eq]

private lemma deriv_deriv_oddWeber (a z : ℂ) :
    deriv (deriv (oddWeber a)) z = (z ^ 2 / 4 + 2 * a - 3 / 2) * oddWeber a z := by
  have h : deriv (oddWeber a) = oddFirst a := funext (deriv_oddWeber a)
  rw [h, deriv_oddFirst, oddSecond_eq]

namespace Complex

/-- The classical parabolic-cylinder function `U(a,z)`, equivalently `D_{-a-1/2}(z)`.
Both confluent series have infinite convergence radius. Reciprocal Gamma zeros
supply the correct coefficients at nonpositive integer parameter values. -/
def parabolicCylinderU (a z : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) * exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4) *
    (((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) * Gamma (1 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({a / 2 + 1 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) -
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) * z * Gamma (3 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({a / 2 + 3 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2))

private lemma parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun (a : ℂ) :
    parabolicCylinderU a = fun z : ℂ => (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) *
      (((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) * evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4) z -
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) * oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4) z) := by
  funext z
  unfold parabolicCylinderU evenWeber oddWeber gaussianFactor m
  ring

/-- The parabolic-cylinder function is entire in its second complex argument. -/
theorem analyticAt_parabolicCylinderU (a z : ℂ) : AnalyticAt ℂ (parabolicCylinderU a) z := by
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]
  exact analyticAt_const.mul
    ((analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4) z)).sub
      (analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4) z)))

/-- Complex differentiability of `U(a,z)` for every value of the order parameter. -/
@[fun_prop]
theorem differentiable_parabolicCylinderU (a : ℂ) : Differentiable ℂ (parabolicCylinderU a) :=
  fun z => (analyticAt_parabolicCylinderU a z).differentiableAt

private lemma deriv_parabolicCylinderU_eq (a z : ℂ) :
    deriv (parabolicCylinderU a) z = (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) *
      (((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) *
          deriv (evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) z -
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) *
          deriv (oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) z) := by
  have he := (analyticAt_evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4) z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have ho := (analyticAt_oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4) z).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have h := ((he.const_mul ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4))).sub
    (ho.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)))).const_mul
      ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4))
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hd
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]
  exact hd

/-- The Weber differential equation in the standard `U(a,z)` normalization. -/
theorem deriv_deriv_parabolicCylinderU (a z : ℂ) :
    deriv (deriv (parabolicCylinderU a)) z = (z ^ 2 / 4 + a) * parabolicCylinderU a z := by
  have haE : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) Set.univ :=
    fun w _ => analyticAt_evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4) w
  have haO : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) Set.univ :=
    fun w _ => analyticAt_oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4) w
  have he := (haE.deriv z (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  have ho := (haO.deriv z (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
  rw [deriv_deriv_evenWeber] at he
  rw [deriv_deriv_oddWeber] at ho
  have h := ((he.const_mul ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4))).sub
    (ho.const_mul ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)))).const_mul
      ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4))
  have hd := h.deriv
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at hd
  have hfun : deriv (parabolicCylinderU a) = fun w : ℂ => (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) *
      (((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) *
          deriv (evenWeber (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) w -
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4)) *
          deriv (oddWeber (a / 2 + 3 / 4)) w) := funext (deriv_parabolicCylinderU_eq a)
  rw [hfun]
  calc
    _ = _ := hd
    _ = _ := by rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]; ring

private lemma m_zero (a b : ℂ) (hb : Gamma b ≠ 0) : m a b 0 = 1 := by
  simp [m, regularizedHGFun_zero, regularizedHGFunCoeff, hb]

private lemma gamma_half_ne_zero : Gamma (1 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
  Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by norm_num)

private lemma gamma_three_halves_ne_zero : Gamma (3 / 2 : ℂ) ≠ 0 :=
  Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by norm_num)

private lemma evenWeber_zero (a : ℂ) : evenWeber a 0 = 1 := by
  simp only [evenWeber, gaussianFactor, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), neg_zero, zero_div,
    exp_zero, one_mul, m_zero a (1 / 2) gamma_half_ne_zero]

private lemma oddWeber_zero (a : ℂ) : oddWeber a 0 = 0 := by
  simp [oddWeber]

private lemma deriv_evenWeber_zero (a : ℂ) : deriv (evenWeber a) 0 = 0 := by
  rw [deriv_evenWeber]
  simp [evenFirst]

private lemma deriv_oddWeber_zero (a : ℂ) : deriv (oddWeber a) 0 = 1 := by
  rw [deriv_oddWeber]
  simp only [oddFirst, gaussianFactor, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0), neg_zero, zero_div,
    exp_zero, sub_zero, zero_mul, add_zero, one_mul,
    m_zero a (3 / 2) gamma_three_halves_ne_zero]

private lemma cpow_half_ofReal (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    (x : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt x : ℂ) := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
  simpa only [ofReal_div, ofReal_one, ofReal_ofNat] using (ofReal_cpow hx (1 / 2)).symm

private lemma sqrt_two_pi :
    (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
  rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ofReal_mul]

private lemma prefactor_sqrt_two_pi (a : ℂ) :
    (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 + 1 / 4) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [ofReal_ofNat] using cpow_half_ofReal 2 (by norm_num)
  calc
    _ = ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) *
        (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      rw [sqrt_two_pi, htwo]
      ring
    _ = (2 : ℂ) ^ ((-a / 2 - 1 / 4) + 1 / 2) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
      rw [cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)]
    _ = _ := by rw [show (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) + 1 / 2 = -a / 2 + 1 / 4 by ring]

/-- The exact classical initial value of `U(a,z)` at `z = 0`. -/
theorem parabolicCylinderU_zero (a : ℂ) :
    parabolicCylinderU a 0 =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 3 / 4) := by
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]
  simp only [evenWeber_zero, oddWeber_zero, mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  ring

/-- The exact first-derivative initial value in the standard `U(a,z)` normalization. -/
theorem deriv_parabolicCylinderU_zero (a : ℂ) :
    deriv (parabolicCylinderU a) 0 =
      -(2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 + 1 / 4) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4) := by
  rw [deriv_parabolicCylinderU_eq, deriv_evenWeber_zero, deriv_oddWeber_zero]
  simp only [mul_zero, mul_one, zero_sub]
  calc
    _ = -((2 : ℂ) ^ (-a / 2 - 1 / 4) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ)) /
        Gamma (a / 2 + 1 / 4) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [prefactor_sqrt_two_pi]; ring

private lemma regularizedConfluent_zero_parameter (b z : ℂ) :
    regularizedHGFun ({0} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) z = (Gamma b)⁻¹ := by
  calc
    _ = ∑' n : ℕ, cf 0 b n * z ^ n := (cf_hasSum 0 b z).tsum_eq.symm
    _ = cf 0 b 0 * z ^ 0 := by
      apply tsum_eq_single 0
      intro n hn
      simp only [cf_eq, ascPochhammer_ne_zero_eval_zero ℂ hn, zero_div, zero_mul]
    _ = _ := by simp [cf_eq]

private lemma m_zero_parameter (b z : ℂ) (hb : Gamma b ≠ 0) : m 0 b z = 1 := by
  rw [m, regularizedConfluent_zero_parameter, mul_inv_cancel₀ hb]

private lemma evenWeber_zero_parameter (z : ℂ) : evenWeber 0 z = gaussianFactor z := by
  rw [evenWeber, m_zero_parameter (1 / 2) _ gamma_half_ne_zero, mul_one]

private lemma oddWeber_zero_parameter (z : ℂ) : oddWeber 0 z = gaussianFactor z * z := by
  rw [oddWeber, m_zero_parameter (3 / 2) _ gamma_three_halves_ne_zero, mul_one]

private lemma gamma_half_sqrt : Gamma (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
  rw [Gamma_one_half_eq]
  exact cpow_half_ofReal Real.pi Real.pi_pos.le

private lemma sqrt_pi_ne_zero : (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [← gamma_half_sqrt]
  exact gamma_half_ne_zero

private lemma gamma_neg_half : Gamma (-1 / 2 : ℂ) = -2 * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
  have h := Gamma_add_one (-1 / 2 : ℂ) (by norm_num)
  rw [show (-1 / 2 : ℂ) + 1 = 1 / 2 by ring] at h
  calc
    _ = -2 * ((-1 / 2 : ℂ) * Gamma (-1 / 2)) := by ring
    _ = -2 * Gamma (1 / 2) := by rw [← h]
    _ = _ := by rw [gamma_half_sqrt]

/-- The Gaussian case `U(-1/2,z) = D₀(z)`. -/
theorem parabolicCylinderU_neg_one_half (z : ℂ) :
    parabolicCylinderU (-1 / 2) z = exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4) := by
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]
  norm_num
  rw [evenWeber_zero_parameter, gamma_half_sqrt, div_self sqrt_pi_ne_zero, one_mul]

/-- The first Hermite case `U(-3/2,z) = D₁(z)`. -/
theorem parabolicCylinderU_neg_three_halves (z : ℂ) :
    parabolicCylinderU (-3 / 2) z = z * exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4) := by
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [ofReal_ofNat] using cpow_half_ofReal 2 (by norm_num)
  have hsq : (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    norm_cast
    exact Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  have hc : (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (-1 / 2) = -(Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) / 2 := by
    rw [gamma_neg_half, sqrt_two_pi]
    field_simp [sqrt_pi_ne_zero]
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_eq_fun]
  rw [show -(-3 / 2 : ℂ) / 2 - 1 / 4 = 1 / 2 by ring,
    show (-3 / 2 : ℂ) / 2 + 1 / 4 = -1 / 2 by ring,
    show (-3 / 2 : ℂ) / 2 + 3 / 4 = 0 by ring, Gamma_zero]
  simp only [div_zero, zero_mul, zero_sub]
  rw [oddWeber_zero_parameter, htwo, hc]
  calc
    _ = ((Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) * z * gaussianFactor z := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [hsq]; norm_num

end Complex

/-!
# Gamma products at the zero argument of U

Legendre duplication converts the canonical initial value of U to the Gaussian
Mellin normalization. The first identity states its precise cancellation condition;
the positive half-plane corollaries give the unshifted and t²-shifted parameters
used in Helfgott, *Major arcs for Goldbach's problem*, arXiv:1305.2897v4, §3.2.

These are identities of the ordinary totalized Gamma product. They do not identify
that product with a meromorphic continuation at a canceled pole.
-/

public section

namespace Complex

/-- Zero-argument Gamma normalization, away from zeros of the denominator Gamma. -/
theorem Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero (s : ℂ)
    (hGamma : Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) ≠ 0) :
    Gamma s * parabolicCylinderU (s - 1 / 2) 0 =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) := by
  have hpow : -(s - 1 / 2) / 2 - 1 / 4 = -s / 2 := by ring
  have harg : (s - 1 / 2) / 2 + 3 / 4 = (s + 1) / 2 := by ring
  have hdup : Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) =
      Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    have htwice : 2 * (s / 2) = s := by ring
    have hhalf : s / 2 + 1 / 2 = (s + 1) / 2 := by ring
    simpa only [htwice, hhalf] using Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half (s / 2)
  have hpower : (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) := by
    rw [← cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_zero, hpow, harg, ← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_eq_iff hGamma).mpr
  calc
    Gamma s * ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ)) =
        (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * Gamma s * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by ring
    _ = ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s)) *
        Gamma s * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by rw [hpower]
    _ = (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) *
        (Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ)) := by ring
    _ = ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2)) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) := by
      rw [← hdup]
      ring

/-- The cancellation condition follows from the actual Gaussian Mellin domain. -/
theorem Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero_of_re_pos (s : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    Gamma s * parabolicCylinderU (s - 1 / 2) 0 =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) := by
  apply Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero
  apply Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
  have hre : ((s + 1) / 2).re = (s.re + 1) / 2 := by simp
  rw [hre]
  linarith

/-- The t² Gaussian weight shifts the Mellin parameter by two. -/
theorem Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero_shift_two (s : ℂ) (hs : -2 < s.re) :
    Gamma (s + 2) * parabolicCylinderU (s + 3 / 2) 0 =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2) * Gamma (s / 2 + 1) := by
  have hpos : 0 < (s + 2).re := by
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < s.re + 2 by linarith)
  have harg : (s + 2) - 1 / 2 = s + 3 / 2 := by ring
  have hhalf : (s + 2) / 2 = s / 2 + 1 := by ring
  simpa only [harg, hhalf, add_sub_cancel_right] using
    Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero_of_re_pos (s + 2) hpos

end Complex

/-!
# The integral representation of the parabolic-cylinder function

The Gaussian moment series splits into the two regularized confluent series
defining canonical `U`. Gamma duplication supplies its exact coefficients in
the actual half-line integral domain of Helfgott, *Major arcs for Goldbach's
problem*, arXiv:1305.2897v4, §3.2.
-/

public section

noncomputable section

open Complex MeasureTheory Set

private lemma gamma_half_sqrt : Gamma (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
  have h := Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half (1 / 2 : ℂ)
  norm_num at h
  exact h

private lemma gamma_three_halves : Gamma (3 / 2 : ℂ) = (1 / 2 : ℂ) * Gamma (1 / 2) := by
  simpa only [show (1 / 2 : ℂ) + 1 = 3 / 2 by ring] using
    Gamma_add_one (1 / 2 : ℂ) (by norm_num)

private lemma factorial_even (k : ℕ) :
    ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (1 / 2) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) * (k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) := by
  have hhalf : (k : ℂ) + 1 / 2 + 1 / 2 = (k : ℂ) + 1 := by ring
  have htwice : 2 * ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) = ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  have hexponent : 1 - 2 * ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) = -((2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
  have h := Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2)
  rw [hhalf, hexponent, htwice, Gamma_nat_eq_factorial k, Gamma_nat_eq_factorial (2 * k),
    ← gamma_half_sqrt, cpow_neg, cpow_natCast] at h
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  calc
    ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (1 / 2) =
        (((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) * ((2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k))⁻¹ * Gamma (1 / 2)) *
          (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) := by field_simp [htwo]
    _ = (Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (k.factorial : ℂ)) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) := by rw [← h]
    _ = _ := by ring

private lemma factorial_odd (k : ℕ) :
    ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (3 / 2) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) * (k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) := by
  have hpos : 0 < ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2).re := by
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 by positivity)
  have hne : (k : ℂ) + 1 / 2 ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_apply_ne re
    simpa only [zero_re] using hpos.ne'
  have hstep : Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) =
      ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) := by
    simpa only [show (k : ℂ) + 1 / 2 + 1 = (k : ℂ) + 3 / 2 by ring] using
      Gamma_add_one ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) hne
  calc
    ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (3 / 2) =
        ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (1 / 2)) := by
      rw [Nat.factorial_succ, gamma_three_halves]
      push_cast
      ring
    _ = ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) *
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) * (k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2)) := by
      rw [factorial_even]
    _ = _ := by rw [hstep]; ring

private lemma mellin_gaussian_half (s : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    mellin (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)) s =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) := by
  have h := (hasMellin_exp_neg_mul_sq (b := 1 / 2) (by norm_num) hs).2
  have hfun : (fun t : ℝ => (Real.exp (-(1 / 2) * t ^ 2) : ℂ)) =
      fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2) := by
    funext t
    rw [ofReal_exp]
    congr 1
    push_cast
    ring
  rw [hfun] at h
  simp only [ofReal_div, ofReal_one, ofReal_ofNat] at h
  have hconstant : (1 / 2 : ℂ) * ((1 / (1 / 2) : ℂ) ^ (s / 2) * Gamma (s / 2)) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) := by
    norm_num
    rw [cpow_sub _ _ (by norm_num), cpow_one]
    ring
  exact h.trans hconstant

private def coefficient (s z : ℂ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  (-z) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ) * ((2 : ℂ) ^ ((s + n) / 2 - 1) * Gamma ((s + n) / 2))

private lemma confluent_coefficient_eq (a b : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    regularizedHGFunCoeff ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) k =
      (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval a / ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (b + k)) := by
  simp [regularizedHGFunCoeff]

private lemma coefficient_even (s z : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) (k : ℕ) :
    coefficient s z (2 * k) =
      ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma (1 / 2)) *
        (regularizedHGFunCoeff ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) k *
          (z ^ 2 / 2) ^ k) := by
  have hA : 0 < (s / 2).re := by simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < s.re / 2 by linarith)
  have hGammaA : Gamma (s / 2) ≠ 0 := Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos hA
  have havoid : ∀ n : ℕ, s / 2 ≠ -n := by
    intro n h
    apply hGammaA
    rw [h, Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero]
  have hratio : Gamma (s / 2 + k) = (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval (s / 2) * Gamma (s / 2) :=
    (div_eq_iff hGammaA).mp (Gamma_add_nat_div_Gamma_eq (n := k) (s / 2) havoid)
  have hGammaK : Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 1 / 2 by positivity)
  have hfac : (k.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero k
  have hfacEven : ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * k)
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have hhalf : (s + ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ)) / 2 = s / 2 + k := by push_cast; ring
  have hexponent : (s + ((2 * k : ℕ) : ℂ)) / 2 - 1 = (s / 2 - 1) + k := by push_cast; ring
  have hz : (-z) ^ (2 * k) = (z ^ 2) ^ k := by rw [pow_mul, neg_sq]
  have hfactorial := factorial_even k
  rw [show (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) = (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (2 : ℂ) ^ k by rw [Nat.two_mul, pow_add]] at hfactorial
  have hdenominator : (2 : ℂ) ^ k / ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) =
      Gamma (1 / 2) / ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hfacEven (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hfac hGammaK) htwo)).mpr
    calc
      (2 : ℂ) ^ k * ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) =
          (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) := by ring
      _ = ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (1 / 2) := hfactorial.symm
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [coefficient, hz, hexponent, cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num), cpow_natCast, hhalf, hratio,
    confluent_coefficient_eq, show (1 / 2 : ℂ) + k = (k : ℂ) + 1 / 2 by ring, div_pow]
  calc
    (z ^ 2) ^ k / ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ) *
        (((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) *
          ((ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval (s / 2) * Gamma (s / 2))) =
        (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval (s / 2) *
          (z ^ 2) ^ k * ((2 : ℂ) ^ k / ((2 * k).factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
    _ = (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval (s / 2) *
        (z ^ 2) ^ k *
          (Gamma (1 / 2) / ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k)) := by
      rw [hdenominator]
    _ = _ := by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]; ring

private lemma coefficient_odd (s z : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) (k : ℕ) :
    coefficient s z (2 * k + 1) =
      -((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z * Gamma (3 / 2)) *
        (regularizedHGFunCoeff ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) k *
          (z ^ 2 / 2) ^ k) := by
  have hB : 0 < ((s + 1) / 2).re := by
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < (s.re + 1) / 2 by linarith)
  have hGammaB : Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) ≠ 0 := Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos hB
  have havoid : ∀ n : ℕ, (s + 1) / 2 ≠ -n := by
    intro n h
    apply hGammaB
    rw [h, Gamma_neg_nat_eq_zero]
  have hratio : Gamma ((s + 1) / 2 + k) =
      (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval ((s + 1) / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) :=
    (div_eq_iff hGammaB).mp (Gamma_add_nat_div_Gamma_eq (n := k) ((s + 1) / 2) havoid)
  have hGammaK : Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos
    simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) + 3 / 2 by positivity)
  have hfac : (k.factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero k
  have hfacOdd : ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_ne_zero (2 * k + 1)
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ k ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)
  have hhalf : (s + ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) / 2 = (s + 1) / 2 + k := by push_cast; ring
  have hexponent : (s + ((2 * k + 1 : ℕ) : ℂ)) / 2 - 1 = (s / 2 - 1 / 2) + k := by
    push_cast
    ring
  have hz : (-z) ^ (2 * k + 1) = -(z * (z ^ 2) ^ k) := by
    rw [pow_succ, pow_mul, neg_sq]
    ring
  have hfactorial := factorial_odd k
  rw [show (2 : ℂ) ^ (2 * k) = (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (2 : ℂ) ^ k by rw [Nat.two_mul, pow_add]] at hfactorial
  have hdenominator : (2 : ℂ) ^ k / ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) =
      Gamma (3 / 2) / ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) := by
    apply (div_eq_div_iff hfacOdd (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hfac hGammaK) htwo)).mpr
    calc
      (2 : ℂ) ^ k * ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) =
          (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (2 : ℂ) ^ k * (k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) := by ring
      _ = ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) * Gamma (3 / 2) := hfactorial.symm
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [coefficient, hz, hexponent, cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num), cpow_natCast, hhalf, hratio,
    confluent_coefficient_eq, show (3 / 2 : ℂ) + k = (k : ℂ) + 3 / 2 by ring, div_pow]
  calc
    -(z * (z ^ 2) ^ k) / ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ) *
        (((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k) *
          ((ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval ((s + 1) / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2))) =
        -((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z *
          (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval ((s + 1) / 2) * (z ^ 2) ^ k) *
          ((2 : ℂ) ^ k / ((2 * k + 1).factorial : ℂ)) := by ring
    _ = -((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z *
        (ascPochhammer ℂ k).eval ((s + 1) / 2) * (z ^ 2) ^ k) *
          (Gamma (3 / 2) / ((k.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((k : ℂ) + 3 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ k)) := by
      rw [hdenominator]
    _ = _ := by simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv]; ring

private lemma hasSum_confluent (a b w : ℂ) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ =>
      regularizedHGFunCoeff ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) k * w ^ k)
      (regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ) w) := by
  have hr : (regularizedHGFunSeries ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ)).radius = ⊤ :=
    radius_regularizedHGFunSeries_eq_top (by simp)
  have h := (regularizedHGFunSeries ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({b} : Multiset ℂ)).hasSum
    (x := w) (by simp [hr])
  simpa only [FormalMultilinearSeries.apply_eq_pow_smul_coeff, regularizedHGFunSeries_coeff,
    smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, regularizedHGFun] using h

private lemma even_normalization (s : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) := by
  have h := Gamma_mul_parabolicCylinderU_zero_of_re_pos s hs
  rw [parabolicCylinderU_zero,
    show -(s - 1 / 2) / 2 - 1 / 4 = -s / 2 by ring,
    show (s - 1 / 2) / 2 + 3 / 4 = (s + 1) / 2 by ring] at h
  calc
    Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)) =
        Gamma s * ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)) := by ring
    _ = _ := h

private lemma odd_normalization (s : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (s / 2)) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) := by
  have hA : 0 < (s / 2).re := by simpa using (show (0 : ℝ) < s.re / 2 by linarith)
  have hGammaA : Gamma (s / 2) ≠ 0 := Gamma_ne_zero_of_re_pos hA
  have htwo : (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) = (Real.sqrt 2 : ℂ) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
    simpa only [ofReal_div, ofReal_one, ofReal_ofNat] using
      (ofReal_cpow (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2) (1 / 2)).symm
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2), ofReal_mul, htwo]
  have hdup : Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) =
      Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by
    simpa only [show 2 * (s / 2) = s by ring,
      show s / 2 + 1 / 2 = (s + 1) / 2 by ring] using Gamma_mul_Gamma_add_half (s / 2)
  have hpower : (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ) =
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) := by
    rw [← cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num), ← cpow_add _ _ (by norm_num)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [← mul_div_assoc]
  apply (div_eq_iff hGammaA).mpr
  calc
    Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) =
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 / 2 : ℂ)) *
          Gamma s * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by rw [hsqrt]; ring
    _ = ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s)) *
        Gamma s * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) := by rw [hpower]
    _ = (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) *
        (Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (1 - s) * (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ)) := by ring
    _ = (2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * (Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)) := by rw [← hdup]
    _ = ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2)) * Gamma (s / 2) := by ring

private lemma hasSum_coefficient (s z : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    HasSum (coefficient s z)
      (mellin (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 - z * (t : ℂ))) s) := by
  have h := hasSum_gaussian_laplace_mellin (s := s) (z := z) hs
  have hfunction : (fun n : ℕ => (-z) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℂ) *
      mellin (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2)) (s + n)) = coefficient s z := by
    funext n
    have hpos : 0 < (s + n).re := by
      simpa only [add_re, natCast_re] using add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hs (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
    rw [mellin_gaussian_half (s + n) hpos]
    rfl
  rw [hfunction] at h
  exact h

private lemma mellin_two_series (s z : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    mellin (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 - z * (t : ℂ))) s =
      ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma (1 / 2)) *
        regularizedHGFun ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) +
      -((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z * Gamma (3 / 2)) *
        regularizedHGFun ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
  have heven : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => coefficient s z (2 * k))
      (((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma (1 / 2)) *
        regularizedHGFun ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    have hf : (fun k : ℕ => coefficient s z (2 * k)) = fun k : ℕ =>
        ((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1) * Gamma (s / 2) * Gamma (1 / 2)) *
          (regularizedHGFunCoeff ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) k *
            (z ^ 2 / 2) ^ k) := funext (coefficient_even s z hs)
    rw [hf]
    exact (hasSum_confluent (s / 2) (1 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).mul_left _
  have hodd : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => coefficient s z (2 * k + 1))
      (-((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z * Gamma (3 / 2)) *
        regularizedHGFun ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) := by
    have hf : (fun k : ℕ => coefficient s z (2 * k + 1)) = fun k : ℕ =>
        -((2 : ℂ) ^ (s / 2 - 1 / 2) * Gamma ((s + 1) / 2) * z * Gamma (3 / 2)) *
          (regularizedHGFunCoeff ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) k *
            (z ^ 2 / 2) ^ k) := funext (coefficient_odd s z hs)
    rw [hf]
    exact (hasSum_confluent ((s + 1) / 2) (3 / 2) (z ^ 2 / 2)).mul_left _
  exact (hasSum_coefficient s z hs).unique (HasSum.even_add_odd heven hodd)

/-- The actual Gaussian Laplace Mellin integral has the canonical parabolic-cylinder
normalization for every complex parameter in its convergence half-plane. -/
theorem mellin_gaussian_laplace_eq_parabolicCylinderU (s z : ℂ) (hs : 0 < s.re) :
    mellin (fun t : ℝ => exp (-(t : ℂ) ^ 2 / 2 - z * (t : ℂ))) s =
      exp (z ^ 2 / 4) * Gamma s * parabolicCylinderU (s - 1 / 2) z := by
  have hpower : -(s - 1 / 2) / 2 - 1 / 4 = -s / 2 := by ring
  have hA : (s - 1 / 2) / 2 + 1 / 4 = s / 2 := by ring
  have hB : (s - 1 / 2) / 2 + 3 / 4 = (s + 1) / 2 := by ring
  have hexp : exp (z ^ 2 / 4) * exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4) = 1 := by
    rw [← exp_add, show z ^ 2 / 4 + -(z ^ 2) / 4 = 0 by ring, exp_zero]
  have hcanonical : exp (z ^ 2 / 4) * Gamma s * parabolicCylinderU (s - 1 / 2) z =
      (Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma ((s + 1) / 2))) *
        Gamma (1 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) -
      (Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (s / 2))) *
        z * Gamma (3 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) := by
    rw [parabolicCylinderU, hpower, hA, hB]
    calc
      _ = (exp (z ^ 2 / 4) * exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4)) *
          ((Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) / Gamma ((s + 1) / 2))) *
            Gamma (1 / 2) *
            regularizedHGFun ({s / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) -
          (Gamma s * (2 : ℂ) ^ (-s / 2) * ((Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) / Gamma (s / 2))) *
            z * Gamma (3 / 2) *
            regularizedHGFun ({(s + 1) / 2} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) := by
        ring
      _ = _ := by rw [hexp, one_mul]
  rw [even_normalization s hs, odd_normalization s hs] at hcanonical
  calc
    _ = _ := mellin_two_series s z hs
    _ = _ := by rw [hcanonical]; ring

/-!
# Analyticity in the order of the parabolic-cylinder function

For every fixed complex argument, the canonical `U(a,z)` is entire in the
complex order `a`. The proof bounds the actual confluent-series coefficients
locally by an exponential series, then applies locally uniform summability.
The reciprocal Gamma factors remain entire at all their zeros.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open Complex

private def coefficient (a : ℂ) (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) : ℂ :=
  regularizedHGFunCoeff ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) n

private lemma coefficient_succ (a : ℂ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient a b (n + 1) = coefficient a b n *
      ((a + n) / (((b : ℂ) + n) * (n + 1))) := by
  have hc : ∀ k ∈ ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ), k ≠ -(n : ℂ) := by
    intro k hk
    simp only [Multiset.mem_singleton] at hk
    subst k
    intro h
    have hr := congrArg Complex.re h
    simp only [Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.natCast_re] at hr
    have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    linarith
  have h := regularizedHGFunCoeff_add_one
    (a := ({a} : Multiset ℂ)) (b := ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ)) (n := n) hc
  simpa only [coefficient, Multiset.map_singleton, Multiset.prod_singleton] using h

private lemma norm_coefficient_succ (a : ℂ) (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖coefficient a b (n + 1)‖ = ‖coefficient a b n‖ *
      (‖a + n‖ / ((b + n) * (n + 1 : ℝ))) := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hbpos : 0 ≤ b + n := by linarith
  have hbnorm : ‖(b : ℂ) + n‖ = b + n := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_natCast] using Complex.norm_of_nonneg hbpos
  have hnnorm : ‖(n + 1 : ℂ)‖ = (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_add, Complex.ofReal_natCast, Complex.ofReal_one] using
      Complex.norm_of_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ n + 1 by positivity)
  rw [coefficient_succ a b hb, norm_mul, norm_div, norm_mul, hbnorm, hnnorm]

private lemma ratio_le (b M : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    (M + n) / (b + n) ≤ 2 * M + 1 := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hp : 0 < b + n := by linarith
  rw [div_le_iff₀ hp]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hM (show 0 ≤ b - 1 / 2 by linarith), mul_nonneg hM hn]

private lemma norm_coefficient_succ_le (a : ℂ) (b M : ℝ)
    (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖coefficient a b (n + 1)‖ ≤ ‖coefficient a b n‖ * ((2 * M + 1) / (n + 1)) := by
  have hn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hp : 0 < b + n := by linarith
  have hnp : (0 : ℝ) < n + 1 := by positivity
  have hna : ‖(n : ℂ)‖ = (n : ℝ) := by simp
  have hnum : ‖a + n‖ ≤ M + n := (norm_add_le a (n : ℂ)).trans (add_le_add ha hna.le)
  rw [norm_coefficient_succ a b hb]
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg _)
  calc
    _ ≤ (M + n) / ((b + n) * (n + 1)) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hnum (mul_pos hp hnp).le
    _ = ((M + n) / (b + n)) / (n + 1) := by rw [div_div]
    _ ≤ _ := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (ratio_le b M hb hM n) hnp.le

private lemma norm_coefficient_le (a : ℂ) (b M : ℝ)
    (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖coefficient a b n‖ ≤ ‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * (2 * M + 1) ^ n / n.factorial := by
  have hK : 0 ≤ 2 * M + 1 := by positivity
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [coefficient, regularizedHGFunCoeff]
  | succ n ih =>
    calc
      _ ≤ ‖coefficient a b n‖ * ((2 * M + 1) / (n + 1)) :=
        norm_coefficient_succ_le a b M hb hM ha n
      _ ≤ (‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * (2 * M + 1) ^ n / n.factorial) *
          ((2 * M + 1) / (n + 1)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ih (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ, pow_succ]
        push_cast
        field_simp

private lemma coefficient_eq (a : ℂ) (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    coefficient a b n = (ascPochhammer ℂ n).eval a /
      ((n.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((b : ℂ) + n)) := by
  simp [coefficient, regularizedHGFunCoeff]

private lemma coefficient_differentiable (b : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (a : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ => coefficient x b n) a := by
  have hfun : (fun x : ℂ => coefficient x b n) = fun x : ℂ =>
      (ascPochhammer ℂ n).eval x / ((n.factorial : ℂ) * Gamma ((b : ℂ) + n)) :=
    funext fun x => coefficient_eq x b n
  rw [hfun]
  exact (ascPochhammer ℂ n).differentiableAt.div_const _

private lemma regularized_eq_sum (a : ℂ) (b : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
    regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) w =
      ∑' n : ℕ, coefficient a b n * w ^ n := by
  change FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalarsSum (fun n => coefficient a b n) w = _
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using
    FormalMultilinearSeries.ofScalars_sum_eq (fun n => coefficient a b n) w

private lemma norm_term_le (a w : ℂ) (b M : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b)
    (hM : 0 ≤ M) (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ M) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖coefficient a b n * w ^ n‖ ≤
      ‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * ((2 * M + 1) * ‖w‖) ^ n / n.factorial := by
  rw [norm_mul, norm_pow]
  calc
    _ ≤ (‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * (2 * M + 1) ^ n / n.factorial) * ‖w‖ ^ n :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (norm_coefficient_le a b M hb hM ha n) (by positivity)
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]; ring

private lemma differentiableAt_regularized_order (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (w a : ℂ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℂ
      (fun x : ℂ => regularizedHGFun ({x} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) w) a := by
  let M : ℝ := ‖a‖ + 1
  let f : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n x => coefficient x b n * w ^ n
  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun n =>
    ‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖ * ((2 * M + 1) * ‖w‖) ^ n / n.factorial
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by dsimp [M]; positivity
  have hu : Summable u := by
    simpa only [u, mul_div_assoc] using
      (Real.summable_pow_div_factorial ((2 * M + 1) * ‖w‖)).mul_left ‖(Gamma (b : ℂ))⁻¹‖
  have hfu : ∀ n x, x ∈ Metric.ball a 1 → ‖f n x‖ ≤ u n := by
    intro n x hx
    have hdist : ‖x - a‖ < 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hx
    have hxM : ‖x‖ ≤ M := by
      have h := norm_add_le (x - a) a
      rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
      dsimp [M]
      linarith
    exact norm_term_le x w b M hb hM hxM n
  have hsum := HasSumUniformlyOn.of_norm_le_summable hu hfu
  have hlocal := (hasSumUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformlyOn.mp hsum).tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn
  have hd := hlocal.differentiableOn
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun t x _ =>
      DifferentiableWithinAt.fun_sum fun n _ =>
        ((coefficient_differentiable b n x).mul_const (w ^ n)).differentiableWithinAt)
    Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hda := hd.differentiableAt (Metric.ball_mem_nhds a (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1))
  have hfun : (fun x : ℂ => ∑' n : ℕ, f n x) =
      (fun x : ℂ => regularizedHGFun ({x} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) w) := by
    funext x
    exact (regularized_eq_sum x b w).symm
  rw [hfun] at hda
  exact hda



private lemma differentiable_regularized_order (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (w : ℂ) :
    Differentiable ℂ
      (fun a : ℂ => regularizedHGFun ({a} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) w) :=
  fun a => differentiableAt_regularized_order b hb w a

private lemma analyticAt_regularized_order (b : ℝ) (hb : 1 / 2 ≤ b) (w a : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ
      (fun x : ℂ => regularizedHGFun ({x} : Multiset ℂ) ({(b : ℂ)} : Multiset ℂ) w) a :=
  (differentiable_regularized_order b hb w).analyticAt a

private lemma analyticAt_inverseGamma_affine (a c : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ => (Gamma (x / 2 + c))⁻¹) a := by
  have h := differentiable_one_div_Gamma.analyticAt (a / 2 + c)
  exact h.comp (f := fun x : ℂ => x / 2 + c) (x := a) (by fun_prop)

private lemma analyticAt_prefactor (a : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ => (2 : ℂ) ^ (-x / 2 - 1 / 4)) a := by
  simp_rw [cpow_def_of_ne_zero (by norm_num : (2 : ℂ) ≠ 0)]
  fun_prop

namespace Complex

/-- For every fixed complex argument, `U(a,z)` is entire in its complex order.
No order is excluded when a reciprocal Gamma coefficient vanishes. -/
theorem analyticAt_parabolicCylinderU_order (a z : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ => parabolicCylinderU x z) a := by
  have hR0 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ =>
      regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 1 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) a := by
    have h := (analyticAt_regularized_order (1 / 2) (by norm_num) (z ^ 2 / 2) (a / 2 + 1 / 4)).comp
      (f := fun x : ℂ => x / 2 + 1 / 4) (x := a) (by fun_prop)
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_ofNat,
      Function.comp_def] using h
  have hR1 : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ =>
      regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 3 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) a := by
    have h := (analyticAt_regularized_order (3 / 2) (by norm_num) (z ^ 2 / 2) (a / 2 + 3 / 4)).comp
      (f := fun x : ℂ => x / 2 + 3 / 4) (x := a) (by fun_prop)
    simpa only [Complex.ofReal_div, Complex.ofReal_one, Complex.ofReal_ofNat,
      Function.comp_def] using h
  have hEven : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ =>
      (Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) * (Gamma (x / 2 + 3 / 4))⁻¹ * Gamma (1 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 1 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) a :=
    ((analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_inverseGamma_affine a (3 / 4))).mul analyticAt_const).mul hR0
  have hOdd : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ =>
      (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) * (Gamma (x / 2 + 1 / 4))⁻¹ * z * Gamma (3 / 2) *
        regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 3 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2)) a :=
    (((analyticAt_const.mul (analyticAt_inverseGamma_affine a (1 / 4))).mul analyticAt_const).mul
      analyticAt_const).mul hR1
  have h : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun x : ℂ =>
      (2 : ℂ) ^ (-x / 2 - 1 / 4) * exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4) *
        ((Real.sqrt Real.pi : ℂ) * (Gamma (x / 2 + 3 / 4))⁻¹ * Gamma (1 / 2) *
            regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 1 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({1 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2) -
          (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) : ℂ) * (Gamma (x / 2 + 1 / 4))⁻¹ * z * Gamma (3 / 2) *
            regularizedHGFun ({x / 2 + 3 / 4} : Multiset ℂ) ({3 / 2} : Multiset ℂ) (z ^ 2 / 2))) a :=
    ((analyticAt_prefactor a).mul
    (show AnalyticAt ℂ (fun _ : ℂ => exp (-(z ^ 2) / 4)) a from analyticAt_const)).mul
      (hEven.sub hOdd)
  simpa only [parabolicCylinderU, div_eq_mul_inv] using h

/-- Differentiability in the order parameter for every complex argument. -/
@[fun_prop]
theorem differentiable_parabolicCylinderU_order (z : ℂ) :
    Differentiable ℂ (fun a : ℂ => parabolicCylinderU a z) :=
  fun a => (analyticAt_parabolicCylinderU_order a z).differentiableAt

end Complex
