/-!
# Second countability of the one-point compactification

The actual OnePoint topology is used. Its countable basis combines a
countable basis of the open original space with complements of a compact
exhaustion. Compact and empty original spaces are included.
-/

@[expose] public section

open Set TopologicalSpace Topology

universe uX

namespace OnePoint

/-- A locally compact Hausdorff second-countable space has a second-countable
one-point compactification. This is a plain proof, not a new global instance. -/
theorem secondCountableTopology (X : Type uX) [TopologicalSpace X]
    [T2Space X] [LocallyCompactSpace X] [SecondCountableTopology X] :
    SecondCountableTopology (OnePoint X) := by
  classical
  let K : CompactExhaustion X := CompactExhaustion.choice X
  let tail : ℕ → Set (OnePoint X) := fun n ↦ (some '' K n)ᶜ
  let B : Set (Set (OnePoint X)) :=
    Set.image some '' countableBasis X ∪ range tail
  have hCount : B.Countable :=
    ((countable_countableBasis X).image (Set.image some)).union (countable_range tail)
  have hBasis : IsTopologicalBasis B := by
    apply isTopologicalBasis_of_isOpen_of_nhds
    · intro U hU
      rcases hU with hU | hU
      · obtain ⟨V, hV, rfl⟩ := hU
        exact isOpen_image_coe.2 (isOpen_of_mem_countableBasis hV)
      · obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := hU
        exact isOpen_compl_image_coe.2 ⟨(K.isCompact n).isClosed, K.isCompact n⟩
    · intro x U hx hU
      induction x using OnePoint.rec with
      | infty =>
          obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := K.exists_superset_of_isCompact
            ((isOpen_iff_of_mem hx).1 hU).2
          refine ⟨tail n, Or.inr (mem_range_self n), ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact infty_notMem_image_coe
          · intro z hz
            induction z using OnePoint.rec with
            | infty => exact hx
            | coe z =>
                by_contra hzU
                exact hz (mem_image_of_mem some (hn hzU))
      | coe x =>
          obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVU⟩ :=
            (isBasis_countableBasis X).exists_subset_of_mem_open hx
              (hU.preimage continuous_coe)
          refine ⟨some '' V, Or.inl (mem_image_of_mem (Set.image some) hV),
            mem_image_of_mem some hxV, ?_⟩
          rintro z ⟨w, hw, rfl⟩
          exact hVU hw
  exact hBasis.secondCountableTopology hCount

end OnePoint

public import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic

/-! # Complex continuous maps as a topological ring for the compact-open topology

Joint continuity is tested on every compact subset of the original domain.
No local compactness or separation assumption on that domain is required.
-/

@[expose] public section
noncomputable section
open Filter Set Topology
namespace ContinuousMap
universe u

/-- Compact restrictions give joint ring continuity for complex continuous maps on any topological domain. -/
instance (priority := 100) complexCompactOpenTopologicalRing
    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] : IsTopologicalRing C(X, ℂ) where
  continuous_add := continuous_add
  continuous_neg := continuous_neg
  continuous_mul := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro p
    change Tendsto (fun q : C(X, ℂ) × C(X, ℂ) => q.1 * q.2)
      (𝓝 p) (𝓝 (p.1 * p.2))
    apply ContinuousMap.tendsto_iff_forall_isCompact_tendstoUniformlyOn.mpr
    intro L hL
    let : CompactSpace L := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hL
    let i : C(L, X) := ⟨Subtype.val, continuous_subtype_val⟩
    have hi : Continuous (fun f : C(X, ℂ) => f.comp i) := i.continuous_precomp
    have ht : Tendsto
        (fun q : C(X, ℂ) × C(X, ℂ) => q.1.comp i * q.2.comp i)
        (𝓝 p) (𝓝 (p.1.comp i * p.2.comp i)) :=
      ((hi.comp continuous_fst).mul (hi.comp continuous_snd)).tendsto p
    apply tendstoUniformlyOn_iff_tendstoUniformly_comp_coe.mpr
    simpa only [← ContinuousMap.mul_comp, ContinuousMap.coe_comp, ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
      Function.comp_apply, i] using
      (ContinuousMap.tendsto_iff_tendstoUniformly.mp ht)

end ContinuousMap

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.CompactOpen

/-!
# Compact-open maps into a discrete space

The compact-open topology on continuous maps from a compact space to a
discrete space is discrete.  The result is exposed as a theorem returning the
typeclass; this file deliberately installs no global instance.

## Main declaration

* `ContinuousMap.discreteTopology_of_compact_domain`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

open Set TopologicalSpace

universe u v

namespace ContinuousMap

/-- The compact-open topology on maps from a compact space to a discrete
space is discrete. -/
theorem discreteTopology_of_compact_domain
    {X : Type u} {Y : Type v}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X]
    [TopologicalSpace Y] [DiscreteTopology Y] :
    DiscreteTopology C(X, Y) := by
  rw [discreteTopology_iff_isOpen_singleton]
  intro f
  let U : Y → Set C(X, Y) := fun y =>
    {g | MapsTo g (f ⁻¹' {y}) {y}}
  have hrange : (range f).Finite :=
    (isCompact_range f.continuous).finite_of_discrete
  have hU : ∀ y ∈ range f, IsOpen (U y) := by
    intro y _
    exact isOpen_setOfPred_mapsTo
      ((isClosed_singleton.preimage f.continuous).isCompact)
      (isOpen_discrete {y})
  have hopen : IsOpen (⋂ y ∈ range f, U y) :=
    hrange.isOpen_biInter hU
  have heq : (⋂ y ∈ range f, U y) = {f} := by
    ext g
    constructor
    · intro hg
      simp only [mem_iInter] at hg
      have hgf : g = f := by
        ext x
        have hm := hg (f x) ⟨x, rfl⟩ rfl
        simpa using hm
      simp [hgf]
    · intro hgf
      have hgf' : g = f := by simpa using hgf
      subst g
      simp only [mem_iInter]
      intro y _ x hx
      exact hx
  rwa [heq] at hopen

end ContinuousMap

module

public import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Compact
public import Mathlib.Topology.Category.TopCat.Monoidal
public import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic

import Mathlib.Tactic.Abel

/-!
# Endpoint correction on the actual compact-open interval

The curve is corrected at its two endpoints by the literal affine
formula on the existing `TopCat.I`. The whole curve depends jointly
continuously on its original curve and both desired endpoints. If its
original endpoints already match, every original curve value is fixed.
No completeness hypothesis is used.
-/

public section

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace ContinuousMap

variable {E : Type u} [AddCommGroup E] [Module ℝ E] [TopologicalSpace E]
  [IsTopologicalAddGroup E] [ContinuousSMul ℝ E]

/-- The actual endpoint-corrected curve retains the original interval parameter. -/
def endpointCorrection (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E) : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) where
  toFun s := γ s +
    (1 - (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ)) • (a - γ 0) +
    (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ) • (b - γ 1)
  continuous_toFun := by
    have ht : Continuous (fun s : TopCat.I.{u} => (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ)) :=
      TopCat.I.homeomorph.continuous.subtype_val
    exact (γ.continuous.add ((continuous_const.sub ht).smul continuous_const)).add
      (ht.smul continuous_const)

private theorem endpointCorrectionApplyComputed (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E)
    (s : TopCat.I.{u}) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b s = γ s +
      (1 - (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ)) • (a - γ 0) +
      (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ) • (b - γ 1) := rfl

/-- Every corrected value is given by the actual original affine endpoint formula. -/
theorem endpointCorrection_apply (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E)
    (s : TopCat.I.{u}) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b s = γ s +
      (1 - (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ)) • (a - γ 0) +
      (TopCat.I.homeomorph s : ℝ) • (b - γ 1) :=
  endpointCorrectionApplyComputed γ a b s

private theorem endpointCorrectionZeroComputed (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b 0 = a := by
  rw [endpointCorrection_apply, TopCat.I.homeomorph_zero]
  change γ 0 + (1 - (0 : ℝ)) • (a - γ 0) + (0 : ℝ) • (b - γ 1) = a
  simp only [sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
  abel

/-- The corrected curve starts at the specified actual left endpoint. -/
theorem endpointCorrection_zero (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b 0 = a := endpointCorrectionZeroComputed γ a b

private theorem endpointCorrectionOneComputed (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b 1 = b := by
  rw [endpointCorrection_apply, TopCat.I.homeomorph_one]
  change γ 1 + (1 - (1 : ℝ)) • (a - γ 0) + (1 : ℝ) • (b - γ 1) = b
  simp only [sub_self, zero_smul, one_smul, add_zero]
  abel

/-- The corrected curve ends at the specified actual right endpoint. -/
theorem endpointCorrection_one (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E) :
    endpointCorrection γ a b 1 = b := endpointCorrectionOneComputed γ a b

private theorem endpointCorrectionSelfComputed (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) :
    endpointCorrection γ (γ 0) (γ 1) = γ := by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro s
  rw [endpointCorrection_apply]
  simp only [sub_self, smul_zero, add_zero]

/-- Correction fixes the entire original curve when given its original endpoints. -/
theorem endpointCorrection_self (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) :
    endpointCorrection γ (γ 0) (γ 1) = γ := endpointCorrectionSelfComputed γ

/-- Matching endpoint equations leave every value of the original curve unchanged. -/
theorem endpointCorrection_eq_self (γ : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E)) (a b : E)
    (h₀ : γ 0 = a) (h₁ : γ 1 = b) : endpointCorrection γ a b = γ := by
  rw [← h₀, ← h₁]
  exact endpointCorrection_self γ

private theorem endpointCorrectionContinuous :
    Continuous (fun p : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E =>
      endpointCorrection p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := by
  apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
  change Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
    z.1.1 z.2 +
      (1 - (TopCat.I.homeomorph z.2 : ℝ)) • (z.1.2.1 - z.1.1 0) +
      (TopCat.I.homeomorph z.2 : ℝ) • (z.1.2.2 - z.1.1 1))
  have ht : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      (TopCat.I.homeomorph z.2 : ℝ)) :=
    (TopCat.I.homeomorph.continuous.comp continuous_snd).subtype_val
  have hγ : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      z.1.1 z.2) := continuous_fst.fst.eval continuous_snd
  have h₀ : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      z.1.1 (0 : TopCat.I.{u})) := (continuous_eval_const _).comp continuous_fst.fst
  have h₁ : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      z.1.1 (1 : TopCat.I.{u})) := (continuous_eval_const _).comp continuous_fst.fst
  have ha : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      z.1.2.1) := continuous_fst.snd.fst
  have hb : Continuous (fun z : (C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E) × TopCat.I.{u} =>
      z.1.2.2) := continuous_fst.snd.snd
  exact (hγ.add ((continuous_const.sub ht).smul (ha.sub h₀))).add (ht.smul (hb.sub h₁))

/-- The whole corrected curve depends jointly continuously on its curve and both endpoints. -/
theorem continuous_endpointCorrection :
    Continuous (fun p : C(TopCat.I.{u}, E) × E × E =>
      endpointCorrection p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) := endpointCorrectionContinuous

end ContinuousMap
